mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window or t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 92.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year growth rate of real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 3.0% signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a delayed monetary policy response to inflation, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of high CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window or t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakening, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of weak PAYEMS and high UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 0.0% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during two consecutive quarters of negative GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05).
